# [reference] External cooler impact on torque converter lock-up

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Evaluate whether installing an external aftermarket ATF cooler is necessary to prevent altered torque converter lock-up caused by bypassed radiator restrictions. [t27]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Evaluate the need for an external aftermarket ATF cooler on vehicles with OEM radiators.
2. Consider that bypassing radiator restrictions might alter torque converter charge pressure.

_Procedure reported by [t27]._
